title: Naengmyeon Noodle Dish
description: A refreshing Korean cold noodle dish, perfect for hot summer days.

ingredients.name: Chewy Korean rice cakes
ingredients.notes: Optional, but recommended for added texture.

instructions: Cook the naengmyeon noodles according to the package instructions, then rinse with cold water to stop cooking.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, thinly sliced Korean pear and cucumber, and shredded iceberg lettuce.
In a small pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and stir-fry the Korean chili flakes for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the sesame oil and stir-fry for another minute.
Pour the stir-fry mixture over the noodles and toss to combine.
Add the chewy Korean rice cakes on top of the noodles, if using.
Pour the cold beef or chicken broth over the noodles and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional sesame oil, if desired.
